name: v0.10.0
body:
## What's Changed
* docs: changelog and blog post for v0.9.2 by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3765
* fix(retain): batch a document's chunk embeddings instead of one request per chunk by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3785
* perf(tokenizer): replace tiktoken with quicktok and default to o200k_base by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3788
* fix(benchmarks): repair retain_memory's imports of removed engine symbols by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3789
* retain: rebuild an oversized item's sub-batch from its original span by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3806
* fix(search): score pg_textsearch results per row by @mameikagou in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3802
* retain: accumulate a document's body instead of rebuilding it per sub-batch by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3809
* fix(coding-agents): don't let one stray file abort the Claude import, and give Prime Agent the companion skill (#3771, #3772) by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3812
* fix(control-plane): scope the Knowledge view's page and mental model ids to the current bank by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3813
* blog: Your Agent Can Now Manage Its Own Knowledge Base Over MCP by @benfrank241 in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3822
* feat(recall): add a per-bank enable_text_search toggle for pure vector recall by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3819
* feat(templates): add Business Executive bank template by @benfrank241 in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3834
* blog: How We Made Retain's Peak Memory Flat, from 4 MB to 90 MB Documents by @benfrank241 in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3839
* fix(transfer): remap mental model evidence ids by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3833
* feat(alembic): let a deployment own a maintenance routine by @cdbartholomew in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3842
* docs: update retain extraction mode documentation by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3838
* feat: export knowledge base in document transfers by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3855
* fix(llm): honor OpenAI's x-ratelimit-reset-* headers on 429s by @romanbsd in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3508
* blog: Cross-Encoder Reranking — The Last Stage of Agent Memory Recall by @benfrank241 in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3868
* fix(retain): bound the within-batch link passes so a delta cannot OOM the worker (#3848) by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3856
* Fix TEI stale socket retries by @oldnicke in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3375
* feat(control-plane): add i18n for knowledge base and refine mental models by @Sanderhoff-alt in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3677
* fix(embeddings): bounded retry/backoff + timeout for litellm/litellm-sdk providers by @icculp in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3090
* fix(worker): detect stuck tasks by stage progress by @BrianHotopp in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3720
* test: restore the global metrics collector instead of leaking it (#3780) by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3816
* fix(providers): native ollama path honours the configured LLM timeout by @MasterST1337 in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3797
* feat(helm): add extraContainers and extraInitContainers to api, worker and control plane by @Adrastopoulos in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3801
* fix(reflect): accept a top-level array of delta operations by @ebarkhordar in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3829
* feat(helm): add Prometheus operator ServiceMonitor support by @aWN4Y25pa2EK in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3847
* perf(local): skip full GC for CPU reranker providers by @Sanderhoff-alt in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3858
* feat(pg_search): allow extension function schema to be configured by @Sanderhoff-alt in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3759
* fix(worker): bound wedged consolidation tasks by @Sanderhoff-alt in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3746
* [CLI] Add a `--trigger-mode full|delta` flag to `mental-models update` by @mdbenito in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3513
* fix(sdk): send only the trigger settings the caller named by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3913
* fix(retain, reflect): drop the source-language rule when an output language is set by @feniix in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3777
* fix(retain): sanitize model-derived fact text by @BrianMcBrayer in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3730
* fix(kb): apply a knowledge-node patch in one transaction by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3914
* fix(admin): sync identity sequences after restore by @r266-tech in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3844
* fix(api): preserve webhook validation status codes by @r266-tech in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3832
* fix(openclaw): add non-interactive flags to plugin install in smoke test by @Sanderhoff-alt in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3917
* feat(mental-models): meter model content by what is delivered, not by which endpoint served it by @cdbartholomew in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3869
* fix(embed): read CLI profile config as UTF-8 by @koriyoshi2041 in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3850
* fix(tests): name the ANN index the plan must use (#3619) by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3911
* fix: propagate configured temperature through reflect calls by @koriyoshi2041 in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3828
* fix(db): memoise InvalidNameError GUC rejections like UndefinedObjectError by @Andreymi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3826

* fix(security): run operation validator in get_mental_model_history (#… by @Sword-Saint69 in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3835

* refactor(bank): eliminate redundant existence queries in _ensure_bank_exists by @Sanderhoff-alt in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3672
* perf(retain): optimize embedding_to_pgvector serialization via zero-copy orjson by @Sanderhoff-alt in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3815
* fix(llm): raise OutputTooLongError when a non-streaming completion is truncated by @ebarkhordar in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3827
* fix: recover Codex OAuth refresh after shared auth rotation by @dwayn in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3804

* fix(coding-agents): stop unsafe gitlog cleanup by @r266-tech in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3879

* fix(llm): derive visible output tokens from total on OpenAI-compatible providers (#3851) by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3920
* fix(coding-agents): stop opencode's install from replacing a JSONC config by @etnperlong in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3843
* feat: expose core mental model trigger settings over MCP by @Sanderhoff-alt in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3739
* docs(docker): add guide and recipe for building CUDA standalone image by @Sanderhoff-alt in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3749

* fix(anthropic): group consecutive tool results into one user message by @zlguo1996 in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3910
* fix(llm): repair malformed JSON in the openai-compatible provider (#3683) by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3935
* fix(documents): skip the retag cascade when a tags PATCH changes nothing (#3912) by @nicoloboschi in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3931
* fix(embeddings): add retry logic and dimensions config for LiteLLM provider (#3695) by @Sanderhoff-alt in https://github.com/vectorize-io/hindsight/pull/3744
